name: Ariel
desc: Never walk alone in the land of None.

1.name: Flashflare
1.desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Active Skill]</color>
Upon activating this skill, soar into the air and dash near the target, attacking a large area of targets and pulling them in. After a short time, generate an [Iridescent Cross] to deal <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. After the pull ends, randomly gain 1/2/3 of the following Buffs based on the number of enemies pulled:
Buff 1: Restore Agent HP;
Buff 2: Restore Agent Energy;
Buff 3: Increases DMG dealt by [Iridescent Cross].
